resources.string: Keeps you on the sums while your wake-up alarm rings, and keeps your daily app limits

Only while a Redemption wake-up alarm is ringing, and never otherwise, this closes the power menu, the uninstall dialog, Settings and other apps, and ignores the volume keys, until you solve the sums. Calls and emergency help are never blocked, and it lets go after an hour. It also keeps the daily app limits you set in Redemption: it counts the time those apps are open and sends you home from one once its time is used up. While limits are set, it can't be turned off and Redemption can't be uninstalled. It only looks at which app or menu has opened, never what you type, and nothing leaves your phone.
